title: One of the best experiences in my life!
text:
One of the best experiences in my life!
We travelled from Seville to Cordoba by car: it was a long ride - approximately 2 hours and half - but very comfortable. Our driver/guide Alfonso kept explaining us interesting things during the drive, on both ways. 
Once we got there, the tour on the boat was fantastic: we were lucky and we actually saw both dolphins and orcas; me and my wife were super-excited!
(hint: we stayed on the lower deck because the sun and wind on the upper deck are too much for us - but you can enjoy the boat ride as you prefer!).
